description: This file defines the DittoMongoClient interface, extending MongoClient, with methods to access the default database, specific collections, and retrieve custom settings, serving as an abstraction layer for MongoDB interactions within the project.

classes.name: DittoMongoClient
classes.description: An interface extending MongoClient, providing methods for accessing default database, collections, and custom settings specific to the Ditto project.

methods.name: getDefaultDatabase
methods.description: Returns the default MongoDatabase instance associated with this client.

methods.name: getCollection
methods.description: Retrieves a MongoCollection for the specified collection name from the default database.

methods.name: getDittoSettings
methods.description: Returns the custom DittoMongoClientSettings associated with this client.
